level5:
Use case: stylized-concept. New crisp pixel-art sprite for an isolated tower-defense visual prototype. Create a LEVEL 5 bridge upgrade between the original third stage and the steel-heavy level10. Original family from reference1, next tier reference2. It must be visibly stronger than the plain original but simpler than level10: squat timber-and-stone platform with strong oak diagonal braces, broad iron straps at joints, muted silver corner caps, short blue pennant. No gold except a small stitched pale crest. Weapon: sturdy SINGLE recurved wooden crossbow with THREE arrow guides and heavy iron limb tips; recognizable old crossbow architecture, not the elaborate full steel triple bow of reference2.
Output one transparent parts sheet, BASE on the LEFT and detached WEAPON on the RIGHT. No text, no scenery. Both parts wholly separated, centered with padding; about 1536x1024. The BASE has no weapon or arrows, a thin open stone firing platform with dark round pivot in the upper half. Front-facing slightly overhead orthographic perspective like the originals, NO rotated isometric angle. Make the building SHORT AND STOUT: visible base aspect ratio width:height about 64:90, NOT a tall building. The mounting disc is about 30 percent down from the top. The wooden facade and foundation are short. Keep blue banner, desaturated blue-gray stone, warm honey wood and dark plum outlines. Native target width64 height90; readable big clusters, original game-pixel style, flat limited palette, hard square pixel edges, no gradients or antialiasing. The detached weapon points STRAIGHT UP, native visible width at most60, height46 inside a96x96 frame centered at48,48. No huge weapon, no spires, no tall parapets, no external shadow or light haze. Genuinely transparent alpha around opaque pixelart. This must fit a 40-unit world grid at scale.63 with towers directly behind it; upgraded power through construction, not larger buildings.
